title: HF4362 (2025-2026 Regular): Visitor carrying of firearms on campuses of public postsecondary institutions regulated.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2026-03-13; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2026/0/HF/4362/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version, 2026-03-13. The bill only relabels old paragraph (c) as (d) (struck text) and adds a cross-reference to the new paragraph (c).

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): (c) A public postsecondary institution regulated under chapter 136F or 137 may establish policies that restrict the carry or possession of firearms by visitors while on the institution's property. A person carrying a firearm in violation of the public postsecondary institution policies may be ordered to leave the premises. A person who fails to leave when so requested is guilty of a petty misdemeanor. The fine for a first offense must not exceed $25. Notwithstanding section 609.531, a firearm carried in violation of this subdivision is not subject to forfeiture.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): (d) Notwithstanding paragraphs (a), (b), and (c), an employer or a postsecondary institution may not prohibit the lawful carry or possession of firearms in a parking facility or parking area.
